# GuardPolicy schema reference

Canonical, portable HOL Guard policy document. The authoritative source is [`schema.json`](../../spec/guard-policy/v1alpha1/schema.json); this page is generated from it.

Add this line to the top of a policy file and your editor validates it as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://guard.hashgraphonline.com/schema/policy/v1alpha1
```

## businessMatch

Versioned business selectors for drafts. Publication requires an authenticated native consumer; parsing alone never authorizes business operations.

| Field | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | yes | `"guard.business-policy-match.v1"` |
| `version` | yes | `1` |
| `services` | yes | array of one of `google_gmail`, `google_drive`, `google_calendar` (min items 1, max items 3, unique items) |
| `operations` | yes | array of one of `mail_read`, `mail_draft`, `mail_send`, `mail_label`, `mail_permanent_delete`, `mail_settings`, `drive_read`, `drive_edit`, `drive_share`, `drive_export`, `calendar_read`, `calendar_invite` (min items 1, max items 12, unique items) |
| `accountBindings` | no | array of string (min length 64, max length 64, pattern `^[a-f0-9]{64}$`) (min items 1, max items 256, unique items) |
| `recipientDomains` | no | array of string (min length 1, max length 253, pattern `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*$`) (min items 1, max items 256, unique items) |
| `audienceKinds` | no | array of one of `private`, `named`, `public` (min items 1, max items 3, unique items) |
| `sensitivityLabels` | no | array of one of `public`, `personal`, `confidential`, `secret` (min items 1, max items 4, unique items) |
| `minRecipientCount` | no | integer (min 0, max 9007199254740991) |
| `minRecordCount` | no | integer (min 0, max 9007199254740991) |
| `minByteCount` | no | integer (min 0, max 9007199254740991) |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditions:

- When `operations` includes `mail_read`, `mail_draft`, `mail_send`, `mail_label`, `mail_permanent_delete` or `mail_settings`, `services` must include `google_gmail`.
- When `operations` includes `drive_read`, `drive_edit`, `drive_share` or `drive_export`, `services` must include `google_drive`.
- When `operations` includes `calendar_read` or `calendar_invite`, `services` must include `google_calendar`.
